documents.text:
Employment terms
Vacation entitlement is twenty working days per calendar year.
Unused leave expires on 31 December and cannot be exchanged for cash.
Paid leave requires prior written approval from the reporting manager.
questions: How much paid leave can I take?
twenty working days
Can I get money instead of taking unused holidays?
cannot be exchanged for cash

documents.text:
Invoice payment terms
The invoice total is INR 18400, inclusive of tax.
Payment must arrive within thirty days of the invoice date.
Late payment incurs interest at one percent per month.
questions: When do I need to settle the bill?
thirty days
What extra charge applies if I pay late?
one percent per month

documents.text:
Home insurance conditions
Fire and theft are covered up to INR 500000.
Flood damage is excluded from this insurance policy.
Each covered claim has a deductible of INR 2500.
questions: Will my plan pay for water damage from flooding?
excluded
How much do I pay myself on a valid claim?
INR 2500

documents.text:
Equipment operating guide
The machine requires an annual safety inspection.
Disconnect the electrical supply before removing the protective cover.
Only a qualified technician may replace the battery.
questions: How often should equipment be checked?
annual safety inspection
Who is allowed to change the power pack?
qualified technician

documents.text:
Residential tenancy agreement
The monthly rent is INR 22000, payable on the fifth day of each month.
The tenant must give sixty days written notice before vacating.
The security deposit is refundable after deducting unpaid utility charges.
questions: How early must I tell the landlord I am moving out?
sixty days
Will I get the entire deposit back if electricity bills are unpaid?
deducting unpaid utility charges

documents.text:
Product warranty
Manufacturing defects are covered for two years from the purchase date.
Accidental damage and normal wear are excluded.
Repair claims require the original purchase receipt.
questions: How long does protection against factory faults last?
two years
What proof do I need to request a free repair?
original purchase receipt

documents.text:
Laboratory report instructions
Collect the blood sample after fasting for eight hours.
The measured haemoglobin is 13.6 g/dL; the reference interval is 12.0 to 15.5 g/dL.
Results must be interpreted by the treating clinician.
questions: How long should I avoid food before the test?
eight hours
What is the measured haemoglobin value and unit?

documents.text:
Course enrolment
The application deadline is 15 June 2030.
Admission is conditional on verification of the original certificates.
Tuition is refundable only if cancellation is received before classes begin.
questions: Does getting accepted depend on checking my qualifications?
conditional on verification
Can I recover course fees after teaching has started?
only if cancellation is received before classes begin

documents.text:
Account statement
The opening balance was INR 12500 and the closing balance was INR 8700.
An unauthorised transaction must be reported within seven days.
The overdraft facility is not enabled for this account.
questions: How quickly do I need to flag a payment I did not make?
seven days
Am I allowed to spend more than the available account balance?
not enabled

documents.text:
Travel reservation conditions
Passengers must reach the departure gate forty minutes before takeoff.
Checked baggage allowance is fifteen kilograms per person.
Tickets are non-refundable after departure.
questions: What is the maximum weight of luggage I can check in?
fifteen kilograms
How early do I need to be at the boarding point?
forty minutes
